Name: Bong Furniture SVE Asset Texture
Author: joythebardlock
Description:
[left]﻿[/left]I was kind of disappointed with the "smelly vase" furniture item texture in Stardew Valley Expanded, so I changed it into Sebastian's bong.

[b][u]NOTE[/u][/b]: [b]It does not change the vase in Sebastian's room.[/b] That requires a separate mod (see below).
[u]
[/u][left][size=5][u]The following colors are included[/u]:
[/size][size=3]Original (Sebastian's)
Red
Orange
Yellow
Green
Blue
Purple
Pink
Rainbow
[/size]Black
White


I have no intention of making a prismatic bong at this time. For that, I suggest the mod "Bring Sebastian's Bong Back" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72707433]SkullJooce[/url]. It's pretty sick but it only changes Sebastian's vase.

Please note that this mod requires "Stardew Valley Expanded" and the mods that are required for it.

[size=5][u]Install instructions[/u]:
[/size]Make sure the game and Vortex are off to avoid potential bugs.
Extract the desired color file from the .rar file, and rename it by removing "_color" from the file so it is just called "SVE_Furniture_TileSheet".
Move the renamed file into your Stardew Valley\Mods\Stardew Valley Expanded\[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded\assets\Items\Furniture directory, and overwrite the file that is there.
That's it. Have fun.

Check out the other mod by me called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36343]Smelly Vase Shop Mod[/url]. When these mods are combined, you can purchase whatever color smelly vase you have chosen from the other mod. The icon is a little smaller than I would like. At some point I may fix it, but again, I am new to coding so it's a miracle I made these.
